companies.name: OYO (PRISM)

parts.SELLS: OYO, whose parent company is now called PRISM, signs up budget hotels and homes under its brands and fills rooms through its app. It owns the Motel 6 and Studio 6 chains in the US, bought in 2024, runs Belvilla holiday homes in Europe, and has premium brands such as Sunday Hotels and Townhouse.
parts.EARNS: Hotel owners pay OYO a commission or fee for bookings, technology and branding; it does not own most of the properties. Motel 6 adds franchise fees in the US. After years of losses, it turned profitable in recent years.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest budget-hotel networks by number of properties.
parts.RIVALS: MakeMyTrip, Booking.com and Agoda for bookings; Treebo, FabHotels and Lemon Tree in budget hotels; Airbnb in homes.
parts.WATCH: Its stock-market listing, which SEBI cleared in June 2026, keeping profits steady, and growth of the US Motel 6 business.

quiz.prompt: How does OYO mainly earn money?
options: Commissions and fees from hotel owners

quiz.prompt: Which US motel chain does OYO own?
What is OYO's parent company now called?

companies.note_30w: OYO, under parent PRISM, earns fees from budget hotels and homes on its platform and owns Motel 6 in the US. Now profitable. Watch its SEBI-cleared IPO and US growth.

companies.name: Dream11 (Dream Sports)

parts.SELLS: Dream11 was India's biggest fantasy-sports app, where users picked teams for real matches and paid to enter contests. After India banned real-money online games in 2025, it stopped paid contests and became a free sports engagement app. Its parent, Dream Sports, also runs FanCode for sports streaming.
parts.EARNS: Before the ban, it took a platform fee from paid contest entries. Now it earns from ads and brand sponsorships shown to its users, and is testing creator watch-alongs and paid features. Press reports say the ban wiped out most of its revenue.
parts.SIZE: Still one of India's most downloaded sports apps, with a very large registered user base.
parts.RIVALS: Sports streaming and fan apps like JioHotstar and FanCode, cricket score apps, and social media.
parts.WATCH: Whether its shift to an AI-first, multi-sport engagement platform, announced in August 2026, can rebuild revenue under new CEO Vaibhav Kokal.

How does Dream11 earn money now?
Which streaming service belongs to Dream Sports?

companies.note_30w: Dream11 lost its paid fantasy contests to India's 2025 real-money gaming ban and became a free, ad-funded sports app. Watch whether its AI-first pivot rebuilds revenue.

companies.name: boAt (Imagine Marketing)

parts.SELLS: boAt sells wireless earbuds, headphones, smartwatches, speakers and chargers at affordable prices, with youthful marketing and celebrity tie-ups. Co-founded by Aman Gupta and Sameer Mehta, it began online and now sells through many shops too.
parts.EARNS: It designs products and markets the brand, while contract manufacturers make them, increasingly in India through partners like Dixon. Earbuds are its biggest category. Margins depend on component costs and discounting.
parts.SIZE: One of India's best-selling audio and wearables brands.
parts.RIVALS: Noise, Fire-Boltt, OnePlus, Realme, JBL (Harman) and Sony.
parts.WATCH: Its planned stock-market listing, the shift to manufacturing in India, and price competition in smartwatches and earbuds.

quiz.prompt: Who makes most boAt products?
Which is boAt's biggest category?
Which is a direct boAt rival?

companies.note_30w: boAt designs and markets affordable earbuds, smartwatches and speakers made by contract manufacturers. Earbuds lead sales. Watch its planned IPO and price competition from Noise and others.

companies.name: Urban Company

parts.SELLS: Urban Company is an app to book trained professionals at home: cleaning, salon and spa, plumbing, electrical and appliance repair, and painting. It sells Native water purifiers and smart locks, launched InstaHelp for quick house help, and operates in the UAE, Singapore and Saudi Arabia. It listed in September 2025.
parts.EARNS: A commission on each service booked, paid from the fee customers pay. It also sells training kits and products to its service professionals, and earns product margins on Native devices.
parts.SIZE: India's largest app for home services.
parts.RIVALS: Local service providers and salons, Housejoy, Snabbit and Pronto in quick house help, and brand-run service networks.
parts.WATCH: Whether InstaHelp can scale profitably, growth of Native products, and professional welfare and earnings, which shape supply.

options: A commission on each service booked

quiz.prompt: What is Native?
options: Urban Company's water purifier and smart-lock brand

quiz.prompt: What is InstaHelp?

companies.note_30w: Urban Company books at-home services like cleaning, salons and repairs, earning a commission per job, plus Native products. Listed in 2025. Watch InstaHelp's economics and professional welfare.

companies.name: Pine Labs

parts.SELLS: Pine Labs supplies card machines and payment software to shops, offers instant EMIs at checkout for big purchases, runs Qwikcilver for corporate and retail gift cards, and offers online payments through Plural and APIs through Setu. It operates in India, Southeast Asia and the Middle East. It listed in November 2025.
parts.EARNS: Fees on payments made through its machines, fees from brands and banks for checkout EMI offers, and fees for issuing and processing gift cards. EMI and gift cards carry higher margins than plain card payments.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest providers of in-store payment terminals for large retailers.
parts.RIVALS: Paytm, PhonePe, Razorpay (Ezetap), banks' own card machines and Mswipe.
parts.WATCH: Growth outside India, the shift of in-store spending to UPI, and its path to steady profit as a listed company.

quiz.prompt: What is Qwikcilver?

companies.note_30w: Pine Labs earns from in-store card machines, checkout EMIs and Qwikcilver gift cards across India and Asia. Listed in 2025. Watch overseas growth, UPI's shift and profitability.

companies.name: BharatPe

parts.SELLS: BharatPe gives small merchants a single QR code that accepts every UPI app, plus card machines, payment speakers and loans. It co-owns Unity Small Finance Bank with Centrum, and runs the PAYBACK India rewards programme.
parts.EARNS: Merchant payments themselves earn little, so BharatPe earns from loans to merchants made through its lending arm and partners, plus rentals on devices. Lending is its main money-maker.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger merchant-payments networks among small shops.
parts.RIVALS: Paytm, PhonePe and Google Pay for merchant QR codes and speakers; NBFCs and banks in merchant loans.
parts.WATCH: Its path to profit, loan quality among small merchants, and the growth of Unity Small Finance Bank.

quiz.prompt: Who are BharatPe's main customers?
What is BharatPe's main money-maker?
Which bank does BharatPe co-own?

companies.note_30w: BharatPe gives small merchants UPI QR codes and devices, earning mainly from merchant loans; it co-owns Unity Small Finance Bank. Watch loan quality and its path to profit.

companies.name: PhysicsWallah

parts.SELLS: PhysicsWallah offers low-cost online courses for exams like JEE, NEET, UPSC and state government jobs, through its app and free YouTube channels. It also runs Vidyapeeth and Pathshala offline coaching centres across India. Founded by teacher Alakh Pandey; listed in November 2025.
parts.EARNS: Course fees. Online courses are priced far below traditional coaching and sell in huge volumes; offline centres charge more and bring a fast-growing share of revenue, but cost more to run.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest test-prep companies by number of students.
parts.RIVALS: Allen, Aakash (Byju's), Unacademy (now part of upGrad), Vedantu and local coaching institutes.
parts.WATCH: Profitability of offline centres, student numbers after exam-season results, and new courses beyond test prep.

quiz.prompt: Which exams does PhysicsWallah mainly prepare students for?
Which part of PhysicsWallah's business is growing fast but costs more to run?
Who founded PhysicsWallah?

companies.note_30w: PhysicsWallah sells low-cost online and offline coaching for JEE, NEET and UPSC, earning course fees. Listed in 2025. Watch offline-centre profitability and student enrolments.

companies.name: Licious

parts.SELLS: Licious sells fresh meat, chicken, fish and seafood, plus marinades and ready-to-cook products, through its app and website, and increasingly through its own experience stores. It controls sourcing, processing and a cold chain to keep products fresh.
parts.EARNS: Margins on the products it sells. Controlling processing and the cold chain lets it charge a premium over local meat shops for quality and hygiene. Chicken is its largest category; ready-to-cook items carry better margins.
parts.SIZE: One of India's leading direct-to-consumer fresh meat brands.
parts.RIVALS: Local butchers, FreshToHome, ZappFresh, and quick-commerce apps that now sell meat.
parts.WATCH: Its path to profit, growth of offline stores, and competition from quick commerce.

quiz.prompt: What does Licious control to keep products fresh?
Why can Licious charge more than local meat shops?
Which kind of app is a growing rival to Licious?

companies.note_30w: Licious sells fresh meat and seafood direct to consumers, controlling processing and cold chain to charge a quality premium. Watch its path to profit and quick-commerce competition.

companies.name: Rebel Foods

parts.SELLS: Rebel Foods runs cloud kitchens, restaurants with no dining room, cooking for brands like Faasos, Behrouz Biryani, Oven Story Pizza, Lunchbox and Sweet Truth. It runs Wendy's in India under franchise and sells through Zomato, Swiggy and its own EatSure app.
parts.EARNS: Margins on food sold, after paying commissions to Zomato and Swiggy. Running many brands from one kitchen spreads rent and staff costs across more orders. Orders through EatSure avoid aggregator commissions.
parts.SIZE: One of the world's largest cloud-kitchen companies.
parts.RIVALS: Restaurant chains like Domino's (Jubilant), McDonald's and Biryani By Kilo, plus thousands of independent restaurants on delivery apps.
parts.WATCH: Its path to profit, commissions charged by delivery apps, and growth of EatSure and Wendy's.

quiz.prompt: What is a cloud kitchen?
options: A kitchen with no dining room that cooks for delivery

quiz.prompt: Which is a Rebel Foods brand?
Why does Rebel Foods push its own EatSure app?

companies.note_30w: Rebel Foods runs cloud kitchens for Faasos, Behrouz and Oven Story, selling mainly via Zomato and Swiggy. Many brands share kitchens. Watch profitability and aggregator commissions.

companies.name: Cars24

parts.SELLS: Cars24 buys used cars from owners, inspects and refurbishes them, and resells them online and through hubs with warranties and returns. It also offers car loans, insurance and services, and operates in Australia and the UAE.
parts.EARNS: The margin between the price it pays owners and the resale price, plus fees for loans, insurance and services. Financing helps sell more cars and earns distribution fees.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest online used-car platforms.
parts.RIVALS: Spinny, CarDekho, OLX Autos, Maruti True Value and local dealers.
parts.WATCH: Used-car margins, growth of its lending and services, and its path to profit.

quiz.prompt: How does Cars24 mainly make money?
options: Margin between buying and reselling used cars

companies.note_30w: Cars24 buys, refurbishes and resells used cars with financing, earning resale margins and fees, also in Australia and the UAE. Watch used-car margins and its path to profit.

companies.name: upGrad

parts.SELLS: upGrad sells online degrees and certificate programmes for working professionals in partnership with Indian and global universities, plus bootcamps, study-abroad services and corporate training through upGrad Enterprise. It completed its acquisition of Unacademy in September 2026, adding test prep.
parts.EARNS: Course fees paid by learners, shared with partner universities, and fees from companies for training their staff. Higher-education programmes for working professionals are its largest business.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest online higher-education companies.
parts.RIVALS: Great Learning, Simplilearn, Coursera, Emeritus, and universities' own online programmes.
parts.WATCH: Integration of Unacademy, demand for upskilling as AI changes jobs, and its path to profit.

companies.name: BigBasket

parts.SELLS: BigBasket sells groceries, fresh produce and household goods online, with BB Now for delivery in minutes and scheduled delivery for larger baskets. It has strong own brands like Fresho and BB Royal. It is owned by the Tata Group through Tata Digital.
parts.EARNS: Margins on groceries, higher on its own brands and fresh produce, plus delivery fees and ads from brands. Sourcing fruit and vegetables directly from farmers helps margins.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest online grocers, now competing in quick commerce.
parts.RIVALS: Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy Instamart, Flipkart Minutes, Amazon Fresh and DMart Ready.
parts.WATCH: How fast it catches up in quick commerce, losses as it builds dark stores, and the plans of new CEO Amit Nanda, who joined from Amazon in June 2026.

companies.note_30w: BigBasket, owned by Tata, sells groceries online with BB Now quick delivery and own brands like Fresho. Watch its quick-commerce catch-up and new CEO Amit Nanda's plans.

companies.name: Go Digit General Insurance

parts.SELLS: Digit is a digital-first general insurer selling motor, health, travel, property and other non-life policies, mostly through partners such as agents, brokers, car dealers and online platforms. Founded by Kamesh Goyal; cricketer Virat Kohli is a shareholder.
parts.EARNS: It collects premiums and pays claims, earning when claims and costs come in below premiums, plus income from investing premiums before claims are paid. Motor insurance is its largest line.
parts.SIZE: One of India's larger private general insurers.
parts.RIVALS: ICICI Lombard, Bajaj General, HDFC Ergo, Acko, Tata AIG and New India Assurance.
parts.WATCH: Its combined ratio (claims plus costs as a share of premiums), motor insurance pricing, and growth in health.

companies.note_30w: Digit is a digital-first general insurer, mostly motor, selling through partners and earning when claims and costs stay below premiums. Watch its combined ratio and health growth.

companies.name: SBI Life Insurance

parts.SELLS: SBI Life sells life insurance: savings plans, unit-linked plans (ULIPs) tied to markets, term protection, group cover and annuities for retirement income. State Bank of India is its parent.
parts.EARNS: Premiums invested until claims and maturities are paid, with profit coming from margins built into each policy. Most policies are sold through SBI's vast branch network, a model called bancassurance, which keeps selling costs low.
parts.SIZE: India's largest private life insurer by new business premiums.
parts.RIVALS: LIC, HDFC Life, ICICI Prudential Life, Axis Max Life and Bajaj Life.
parts.WATCH: Growth in value of new business (VNB), the profit expected from policies sold in a year, the mix shift towards protection, and tax rule changes on insurance.

quiz.prompt: What is bancassurance?
Who is SBI Life's parent?

options: Profit expected from policies sold in a year

companies.note_30w: SBI Life is India's largest private life insurer, selling mostly through SBI branches. Profit comes from margins in each policy. Watch value of new business and protection mix.

companies.name: HDFC Life Insurance

parts.SELLS: HDFC Life sells life insurance: guaranteed and participating savings plans, ULIPs, term protection, annuities and group cover. HDFC Bank is its parent after the 2023 HDFC merger.
parts.EARNS: Margins built into policies, earned over their life. HDFC Bank is its biggest sales channel; agents, brokers and online sales add more. Non-participating savings and protection plans carry its highest margins.
parts.SIZE: One of India's three largest private life insurers.
parts.RIVALS: SBI Life, LIC, ICICI Prudential Life, Axis Max Life and Bajaj Life.
parts.WATCH: Value of new business growth, dependence on HDFC Bank for sales, and margins as product mix and tax rules change.

quiz.prompt: Who is HDFC Life's parent company?
Which is HDFC Life's biggest sales channel?
Who leads HDFC Life?

companies.note_30w: HDFC Life, owned by HDFC Bank, sells savings, protection and annuity policies, mainly through the bank. Margins come from product mix. Watch value of new business and bank dependence.

companies.name: Indian Hotels (Taj)

parts.SELLS: Indian Hotels runs Taj luxury hotels, Vivanta and SeleQtions upscale hotels, Ginger lean-luxe hotels, ama Stays homestays and Qmin food delivery. It also owns Taj SATS airline catering. It is a Tata Group company.
parts.EARNS: Room rates and occupancy, food and beverage, and fees for managing hotels owned by others. Management contracts let it add hotels without heavy investment, an asset-light model. Taj is the profit engine.
parts.SIZE: India's largest hospitality company by market value.
parts.RIVALS: ITC Hotels, EIH (Oberoi), Leela, Marriott, Hyatt, Lemon Tree and Chalet.
parts.WATCH: Room rates during strong travel demand, its pipeline of new signings, and the growth of Ginger and ama Stays.

options: Managing hotels owned by others for a fee

quiz.prompt: Which is Indian Hotels' luxury brand?
Which group does Indian Hotels belong to?

companies.note_30w: Indian Hotels, a Tata company, runs Taj, Vivanta and Ginger, earning from rooms, food and management fees. Taj drives profit. Watch room rates and new hotel signings.

companies.name: Muthoot Finance

parts.SELLS: Muthoot Finance gives short-term loans against gold jewellery through thousands of branches across India. It also has subsidiaries in microfinance (Belstar), housing finance and insurance broking, and a lender in Sri Lanka.
parts.EARNS: Interest on gold loans, which are quick to approve and safe because the gold can be sold if a borrower defaults. Higher gold prices let customers borrow more against the same jewellery. Gold loans are the vast majority of its book.
parts.SIZE: India's largest gold-loan company.
parts.RIVALS: Manappuram Finance, IIFL Finance, and banks such as SBI, Federal Bank and HDFC Bank that also give gold loans.
parts.WATCH: Gold prices, RBI's tighter gold-loan rules introduced in 2025, competition from banks, and microfinance stress at Belstar.

companies.note_30w: Muthoot Finance is India's largest gold-loan company, earning interest on quick, secured loans. Higher gold prices lift loan sizes. Watch gold prices and RBI's new gold-loan rules.

companies.name: Adani Green Energy

parts.SELLS: Adani Green builds and runs solar, wind and hybrid power plants across India. Its flagship is the Khavda renewable energy park in Gujarat's Rann of Kutch, planned to be the world's largest renewable plant. It is part of the Adani Group.
parts.EARNS: Selling electricity under long-term contracts, mostly multi-decade power purchase agreements with government agencies like SECI and state utilities, at fixed tariffs. Earnings grow as new capacity comes online; building it needs heavy borrowing.
parts.SIZE: India's largest renewable energy company by operating capacity.
parts.RIVALS: NTPC Green Energy, ReNew, Tata Power Renewables, JSW Energy and Greenko.
parts.WATCH: Commissioning at Khavda, debt levels and refinancing, and the outcome of the US case filed in November 2024 against Gautam Adani and others, which the group denies.

quiz.prompt: What is Khavda?
options: Adani Green's giant renewable park in Gujarat

quiz.prompt: How does Adani Green sell most of its power?
What does building new renewable capacity require?

companies.note_30w: Adani Green, India's largest renewable producer, sells solar and wind power under long-term fixed contracts, led by Gujarat's Khavda park. Watch commissioning, debt and the US legal case.

companies.name: Adani Power

parts.SELLS: Adani Power runs coal-fired power plants in Gujarat, Maharashtra, Rajasthan, Karnataka, Chhattisgarh, Madhya Pradesh and Jharkhand. Its Godda plant in Jharkhand sends all its power to Bangladesh. It has grown by buying stressed power plants.
parts.EARNS: Long-term power purchase agreements with state utilities cover most capacity, paying for fuel and a fixed charge; some power is sold on exchanges at market prices, which lifts profit when demand peaks.
parts.SIZE: India's largest private thermal power producer.
parts.RIVALS: NTPC, Tata Power, JSW Energy and Torrent Power.
parts.WATCH: Its large new coal-plant expansion, payments from Bangladesh for Godda power, coal costs, and peak electricity demand.

quiz.prompt: Which country receives all power from Adani's Godda plant?
What fuel do Adani Power's plants use?
When does selling power on exchanges lift Adani Power's profit?

companies.note_30w: Adani Power, India's largest private thermal producer, sells coal power under long-term contracts plus exchanges; Godda supplies Bangladesh. Watch expansion, Bangladesh payments and coal costs.

companies.name: Bajaj Housing Finance

parts.SELLS: Bajaj Housing Finance gives home loans, mostly to salaried professionals, plus loans against property, loans to developers and lease rental discounting for commercial property owners. It is a subsidiary of Bajaj Finance and listed in September 2024.
parts.EARNS: The spread between interest on loans and its cost of borrowing. Its top credit rating and Bajaj backing let it borrow cheaply, and its bad-loan levels are very low. Home loans are the largest part of its book.
parts.SIZE: One of India's largest housing finance companies.
parts.RIVALS: LIC Housing Finance, PNB Housing, HDFC Bank, SBI and ICICI Bank in home loans.
parts.WATCH: Loan growth versus thinner margins in a competitive home-loan market, and interest-rate changes.

Why can Bajaj Housing borrow cheaply?
options: Top credit rating and Bajaj backing

quiz.prompt: Who are its main home-loan customers?

companies.note_30w: Bajaj Housing Finance lends mostly to salaried home buyers, earning a spread helped by cheap borrowing and very low bad loans. Watch margins in a competitive home-loan market.

companies.name: Unacademy

parts.SELLS: Unacademy offers online test prep for UPSC, JEE, NEET, banking and other exams through live classes and its app. It also built Airlearn, a language-learning app, and Graphy, a platform for creators to sell courses. upGrad completed its acquisition of Unacademy in September 2026.

parts.SIZE: Once one of India's most valuable ed-tech startups; now part of upGrad.
parts.RIVALS: PhysicsWallah, Allen, Aakash, Adda247 and free YouTube educators.

What is Airlearn?

companies.note_30w: Unacademy sells test-prep subscriptions for UPSC, JEE and NEET, and built Airlearn. upGrad completed its acquisition in 2026. Watch integration and educator retention.

companies.name: Acko

parts.RIVALS: Digit, ICICI Lombard, Bajaj General, HDFC Ergo and Policybazaar as a marketplace.

companies.note_30w: Ather makes premium e-scooters like Rizta and the 450, earning from scooters, software and charging; Hero is a big shareholder. Listed in 2025. Watch growth beyond the south.

companies.name: Star Health Insurance
